Atomic model units hbar=m=1 and HO omega=1. The box[0,1] and finite HO[-L,L] domains both use homogeneous Dirichlet conditions. Eight full solves save824raw pairs; qualification applies to24selected pairs. Thresholded nodes/phase are diagnostics.
